summary: Independent incremental final review passed for the new EOF-only revision. Against the prior reviewer-recorded raw hashes, only main.tex and lean4/lakefile.lean changed, each by deleting exactly two trailing CRLF blank lines; all 17 other frozen non-generated files are byte-identical. The prior independent mathematics/source/Lean review remains applicable. Reviewer actually reran all 40 focused tests and full offline clean own-project reproduction on this new frozen package, checked nine dependencies and 36 theorem types/axioms, and independently rendered and inspected both unchanged PDF pages again. All checks passed without a new blocker. This is not a coordinator hash substitution, release authorization or upstream acceptance.

independence.statement: This reviewer did not author or modify the submitted mathematical Lean sources, manuscript, alignment, manifest, reproducer, or tests. Reviewer-authored execution helpers and evidence are outside the submission. Implementation logs were not used as evidence of reviewer execution.
independence.implementation_agent_as_disclosed: Codex coordinator and prior coprime-counting worker; Ampere reproducer worker
independence.shared_infrastructure: Local Lean toolchain and dependency build caches are shared. AI-agent independence is not human expert endorsement.

incremental_revision.scope: Exactly two trailing CRLF blank lines (four raw bytes) removed from each of main.tex and lean4/lakefile.lean. Re-appending those exact bytes recovers each prior raw SHA-256; normalized contents also match the preserved prior Git index. All 17 other non-generated frozen files remain byte-identical. Prior mathematical review therefore remains applicable. No source edit was made by the reviewer.

source.scope: Both languages checked. No number field is specified by the source. ALIGNMENT.md and manifest accurately disclose the standard rational interpretation and do not claim an unstated alternative convention. Every finite witness subset would obey an asserted bound on the full solution count, so the closed finite-subset negation suffices.

mathematics.construction: All ordered coprime pairs 1<=a,b<=N map injectively to (a/(a+b),b/(a+b)); both coordinates are nonzero rational S-units for primes <=2N.
mathematics.bounds: At least N^2/4 witnesses. For positive m, N_m=2^(2m), X_m=2N_m, S_m=S_{N_m}; small weighted cardinality <=2N_m and large <=4N_m yield m|S_m|<=6N_m. The witness/support-square ratio is at least m^2/144 and exceeds every proposed absolute constant.
mathematics.bridge: RatBridge uses actual reduced Rat.num/Rat.den supports. GeneratedUnits proves the constructed witnesses belong to the subgroup generated by -1 and supported primes; a general bidirectional equivalence of both definitions is not claimed or needed.

offline_reproduction.verified: Exact source commit/blob/raw SHA; nine physical Git checkouts with fixed HEAD/origin, clean tracked source bytes and index/tree equality before and after; only own-project .lake/build cleared; offline warning-as-error Main build; five mathematical modules plus Main source replay; final Check source execution; exact 36-theorem type/axiom inventory; bounded exact Fraction/integer regressions; authored package stability.
offline_reproduction.prohibited_items: No sorry, admit, custom axiom, native_decide, unsafe evaluation or executable elaboration item in authored Lean sources. Kernel decide uses for elementary constants are not a surrogate proof of the mathematical assertion.

windows_linktext.verdict: Narrow exception acceptable; no general link-following permission
windows_linktext.scope: Only these three fixed mode-120000 blobs on fixed dependency commits may be exact ordinary Windows target-text files. Their raw bytes were independently compared to Git blobs. No EOL fallback, target following or execution for them. Unknown 120000 entries, physical reparse points, gitlinks and modified placeholders remain rejected, including focused negative tests and a real junction preservation test.

pdf.assessment: Both final pages visually inspected: readable text/formulas, no evident clipping, overlap or missing glyphs. Positive m, corrected N/X/S definitions, bounds and bridge descriptions match the final TeX and Lean.

evidence.hash_stability: Coordinator hash independently executed before and after reproduction; both equal the bound content_sha256. PDF raw SHA remained unchanged. Root review.json is excluded by the coordinator content-hash algorithm.

scope_and_trust: Clean own-project reproduction, not full dependency rebuild or clean-machine bootstrap.
Installed Lean 4.33.1 compiler, pinned Mathlib and existing dependency compiled caches remain trusted infrastructure.
Filesystem checks are not a hostile-process sandbox and do not eliminate malicious concurrent check-to-use races.
No PDF recompilation was performed by the reviewer; final actual PDF was hashed, rendered and inspected.
No networking, credentials, claim, commit, push, PR, Issue or release operation was performed during this final review.
No assertion of originality, human endorsement, upstream acceptance, award, or publication permission.
